settings.heading: The Royal Oudh Collection
settings.subheading: Rare botanical oils, pure agarwood essence, and Damascus rose slow-infused inside golden decanters.

settings.heading: Slow Distilled. Golden Aged.
settings.body: Our oudh is slowly extracted from 30-year mature Aquilaria trees, then aged for 24 months in dark glass vessels to achieve unrivaled olfactory depth.

settings.quote: The sillage of the Royal Amber is legendary. Easily lasts 24 hours on silk layers.
